demo.title: harness-venice.sh
demo.code:
# One-time setup: buy DIEM on Base, stake it, mint an agent-owned INFERENCE key
bankr prompt "Fund Venice inference: buy $50 of DIEM, stake it, and mint my API key"

# Check today's DIEM allowance and remaining balance
bankr prompt "Check my Venice DIEM balance"

# Rotate a lost or exposed key
bankr prompt "Rotate my Venice API key"

# Put the stake on YOUR OWN Venice account instead (EOA handoff)
bankr prompt "Buy $50 of DIEM and send it to my wallet 0x... so I can stake it on my Venice account"

setup: Agent wallet on Base with USDC/ETH to buy DIEM (amount is always human-confirmed first)
The web3 key mint requires the wallet to hold a non-zero sVVV balance — a small VVV stake (human-approved) or the EOA handoff flow covers this
DIEM stakes on the DIEM token contract itself (0xF4d9...a024); 1 staked DIEM = $1/day Venice API allowance, resets 00:00 UTC
The minted key is shown once over a private channel, saved to the secret store as VENICE_API_KEY, then last-4 only forever
